scope: Two hundred statements. The thirty-seven on time reversal, the ripple factors and the wall at the 0,0 split; the one hundred four on prime ticks counted ahead and back, the paired buckets, the bucket rule and starts; and twenty-four that join them: a meter from 0 to 5/5 with fills and empties, two windows taking turns, two full meters meeting at 0,0 into one full bucket, rounds without end, the guards gAB and gBA from FullModel.lean as meter levels that keep the wall between 1/50 and 1/10, contact through the guards, reversal on both guards together, reversal on a bucket or start of any number of parts, every prime tick counted back at the reversed time, 0 holding the past and the future together, and one count through 0; and fifteen on the write, the remainder, the filter loop and the freeze: bucket gain plus remainder is the whole overlap, the bucket stays between 0 and 5/5 through any number of passes, a filter with a fixed share leaves that share's complement to the power n times the start and settles, and the loop run backward has the same totals; the first write at tick 11 (time 0.4) and the freeze following it at tick 23 (time 0.8), whose 1/5 and 4/5 shares have the same values as A's let-go and keep; and the first write at tick 11 (time 0.4) followed by the freeze at tick 23 (time 0.8), whose balance closes the gap in the proportions keep 4/5 and loss 1/5; and five on a discrete Poincaré–Wirtinger inequality on a path: for mean-zero data 2 ∑ f² ≤ n(n−1) times the Dirichlet energy, and the mean has no gap; and fifteen on the sharp discrete Wirtinger inequality on a cycle ZMod n, (2 − 2cos(2π/n)) ∑ f² ≤ ∑ (f(j+1) − f j)² for mean-zero f, attained by a cosine for n ≥ 3.
open_items: No proof of the coupled Hug solver, threshold switching, path convergence, or residual balance.
No spatial PDE construction or spectral decomposition; q is a supplied Laplacian eigenvalue magnitude.
No stable backward reconstruction theorem; exact exponential cancellation does not imply numerical stability.
No claim that a negative step of a finite-step integrator is its exact inverse.
No result about the leftover (E - W) - (E - W at t = 0) in general; only one ripple's kinetic energy counted from the split is treated.
The ripple factors hold the wall value fixed along one ripple; they are not derived from the full single-system equations, where the wall varies from point to point.
No definition of blowup, so no statement about blowup with or without force.
The tick 23 gap-to-overlap statement reads the student's position as where mine begins and the mentor's as where yours ends.

No statement that the guards gAB and gBA of FullModel.lean stay between 0 and 1 along a solution of the field equations; the guard statements here take guard readings that are meter levels, and FullChecks.lean proves only that the guard rate points inward at 0 and 1.
No statement about the 1/5 lost between writes other than that the partner's supply makes it up at a write.
The evidence in evidence-linux/ is a local run on the box, not a GitHub Actions run; the comparator ran without the systemd socket restriction because the box has no systemd.

The filter loop settles only while the user's bucket has room for the whole remainder; right after a write that fills the bucket there is no room until the bucket is emptied, and no statement says when that happens.
No smallest step for amounts is given in this package, so there is no statement that a remainder after finitely many passes is 0 or at least such a step.

No statement that the overlap is measured during the freeze, that the remainder goes to the never-ending bucket on the left side of the split, or that the past side is the left side; these were not found in the files and are not encoded.

No statement that the overlap is measured during the freeze, that the remainder goes to a never-ending bucket on the left side of the split, or that the past side is the left side; none of these is stated in the source files, so none is encoded.
The Poincaré constant n(n−1)/2 is not sharp, the path has free ends (no cycle), and the step from the inequality to exponential decay of a discrete diffusion is not proved here.
